workout.warmup: Your 15-min walk to the gym is your warmup. DO ramp-up sets on the leg press (a light 8, then a medium 5) before the heavy work.
workout.coach_note: Legs are recovered (hilly run Thu, walk Fri, upper Sat) — good to go heavy. This is the lower day that got bumped from Saturday. Main lifts heavy 4x6, accessories 10-12. Two carry-overs from Day 1: DB RDL is OUT (PF DBs cap at 75, grip failed) — hinge is on the SMITH machine now; leg curl at 65 (70 broke down), leg extension up (60 too easy). You're at this gym through ~7/24, so a couple more heavy sessions then we deload.

exercises.name: Leg Press [HEAVY]
exercises.detail: 450 lb plates (+167 sled) · 4 x 6 · 2–3 min rest
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT. On 7/14 you hit 450 for 6 and it was tough. Same 450, but own all 4 sets of 6 clean this time. Ramp up first (360 x8, then a medium 5). If 6 is clean on every set, add next time.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift [HEAVY]
exercises.detail: 4 x 6 · 2–3 min rest · straps if arrived
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT — replaces DB RDL (75 lb DB cap was your ceiling). Ballard Smith bar = 25 lb; load ~135–155 total, adjust so 6 is hard but clean. Hinge from the hips, soft knees, flat back, bar close, feel the hamstring stretch. Straps if they've come.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: 65, not 70 — you broke down to 6 reps on set 3 at 70 last time. 65 should hold 10–12 across all three. Keep the squeeze-and-hold at the contraction.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: Up from 60 (too easy — 10 clean every set). Squeeze at the top, slow negative.

exercises.name: Core Circuit (fresh combo) — 2 rounds
exercises.detail: Cable Crunch x12 → Bicycle Crunch x24 → Side Plank 45–60s/side
exercises.note: Different from your recent circuits. Side planks 45–60s per your own read. Skipping hanging knee raises so grip is fresh for the RDL.
